Relevant findings:
- [sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10:libcontainer/standard_init_linux.go?L195-L207](/r/github.com/sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10/-/blob/libcontainer/standard_init_linux.go?L195-L207) - Resolves the configured entrypoint with `exec.LookPath`, checks execute access, and returns permission-related errors before execution.
- [sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10:libcontainer/standard_init_linux.go?L233-L262](/r/github.com/sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10/-/blob/libcontainer/standard_init_linux.go?L233-L262) - Calls `system.Exec(...)`, which reaches `syscall.Exec`/`execve`; kernel errors such as `ENOEXEC` (“exec format error”) and `EACCES` (“permission denied”) originate here.
- [sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10:libcontainer/factory_linux.go?L274-L285](/r/github.com/sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10/-/blob/libcontainer/factory_linux.go?L274-L285) - Serializes initialization failures, including the `execve` error, back to the parent runc process.

- [sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10:libcontainer/init_linux.go?L253-L256](/r/github.com/sg-evals/runc--v1.1.10/-/blob/libcontainer/init_linux.go?L253-L256) - Parent/init synchronization immediately before executing the configured process.

Root cause/remediation: image platform selection is not sufficient; the entrypoint must be executable, have a valid architecture-appropriate interpreter, and use an explicit shebang such as `#!/bin/sh` or `#!/usr/bin/env bash`. Validate these during image CI/build (including `file`, `readelf`, shebang and mode checks), run startup smoke tests on every target architecture, and use admission/scanning checks to reject scripts lacking a valid shebang or executable bit.
